sources.context: Official Genshin Impact Version 5.7 equipment/configuration UX details; design reference only.
Small anecdotal thread; replies specifically complain about preset naming/default-name friction and spaces. Current official resolution not established.

increments.title: Non-mutating equipment comparison
increments.acceptance: Owned compatible module/weapon previews expose exact authoritative profile deltas without mutating the live loadout; rejected previews fail atomically.

increments.title: Focus-aware owned-module recommendation
increments.acceptance: Balanced/Assault/Guard/Recovery/Mobility focuses deterministically rank only owned slot-compatible modules and never auto-equip.

increments.title: Resonance-family recommendation filter
increments.acceptance: Any/Cooling/Rift/Civic filters restrict suggestions; missing or malformed families return unavailable without mutation.

increments.title: Current-slot versus whole-build recommendation scope
increments.acceptance: CurrentSlot scores direct module contribution without newly activated family synergy; WholeBuild scores the full resulting profile and can legitimately choose a different candidate.

increments.title: Last-successful preset recall and reapply
increments.acceptance: Only successful preset application becomes remembered; failed applies do not replace it; reapply routes through existing preset validation.

increments.title: Human-readable clearable preset labels with spaces
increments.acceptance: Saved slots accept bounded labels with internal spaces; invalid edits are atomic; label clearing does not alter the saved build or current equipment.
